description: This source file defines extension methods for the GrainId class, providing functionality to create, parse, and extract keys (both integer and GUID types) from GrainId instances. It includes methods to generate IdSpan representations for various key types and to parse grain identifiers back into key components.

classes.name: GrainIdKeyExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for creating and parsing grain primary keys as IdSpan objects, supporting both integer (long) and GUID types along with optional key extensions.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long key, formatted as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey (with keyExtension as ReadOnlySpan<byte>)
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long key and an optional key extension given as a byte span.

methods.name: CreateIntegerKey (with keyExtension as string?)
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a long key with a string key extension, if provided.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key formatted as a 32-character hexadecimal string.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey (with keyExtension as ReadOnlySpan<byte>)
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key with an additional byte span as key extension.

methods.name: CreateGuidKey (with keyExtension as string?)
methods.description: Creates an IdSpan representing a Guid key with an optional string key extension.

methods.name: TryGetIntegerKey (extension)
methods.description: Tries to parse the GrainId's Key to extract the long key and optional key extension string.

methods.name: TryGetIntegerKey (internal version)
methods.description: Attempts to get the long key from GrainId without the extension.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey
methods.description: Returns the long key from the GrainId, throws if parsing fails, also outputs key extension.

methods.name: GetIntegerKey (overload)
methods.description: Returns the long key from the GrainId, throws if parsing fails.

methods.name: TryGetGuidKey (extension)
methods.description: Attempts to parse the GrainId's Key as a Guid and optional extension string.

methods.name: TryGetGuidKey (internal version)
methods.description: Attempts to parse the GrainId's Key as a Guid without extension.

methods.name: GetGuidKey
methods.description: Returns the Guid primary key from the GrainId, throws if parsing fails, along with optional extension.

methods.name: GetGuidKey (overload)
methods.description: Returns the Guid primary key from the GrainId, throws if parsing fails.
